action: Taiwanese businesses: patch internet-facing systems, remove weak passwords and report breaches to MODA within 72 hours. Customers: ignore callers or LINE accounts citing your orders to cancel payments.
exec: Official confirmation that AI-automated intrusion tooling is driving a breach wave in Taiwan, with 72-hour reporting duties being enforced.
plain: Taiwan's government says hackers using AI tools broke into more than 10 companies, exposing over a million people's names, phone numbers and order details.
summary: The ministry said a wave of attacks since mid-September hit more than 10 Taiwanese businesses and online platforms and affected over 1 million personal records, with early findings linking some intrusions to the ARTEX automated tool. No payment data theft is confirmed. Separately, 91APP and ezTravel have disclosed breaches. Firms must report breaches to the ministry within 72 hours.
title: Taiwan says AI was involved in nearly half of recent attacks on more than 10 businesses

validation.note: National news agency report of the ministry's press conference.
